Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 24, 2026

Remote Mouse Jiggler (package: com.heymeowcat.remotemousejiggler), developed by heymeowcat, is committed to safeguarding your privacy.

This application operates strictly as a local Bluetooth Human Interface Device (HID) peripheral (mouse, keyboard, media remote, and automated jiggler). We do not collect, store, share, or transmit any personal data whatsoever.

1. Zero Data Collection

Remote Mouse Jiggler is designed with privacy at its core:

  • No Keystroke Logging: Any keys, shortcuts, or text you type via the virtual keyboard are transmitted directly over standard Bluetooth HID to your connected receiver and are never logged or stored.
  • No Cursor Tracking: Mouse coordinates, gyro air-mouse motion data, and jiggler patterns exist only in transient device memory during active sessions.
  • No Account Required: The app does not require logins, accounts, email addresses, or personal profiles.
  • No Telemetry: No analytics, crash telemetry, diagnostic trackers, or behavioral profiling exist in the application.

2. No Internet Access

The application does not request or use the Android INTERNET permission. It is technically incapable of sending data from your device to any external server or cloud service. All communication is exclusively peer-to-peer over local Bluetooth hardware.

3. Android Permissions & Purpose

Remote Mouse Jiggler requests only the permissions necessary to establish and maintain Bluetooth HID connections and run automated background jiggling:

Permission Purpose
BLUETOOTH_CONNECT Allows the app to connect directly to paired PCs, Macs, TVs, and receiver devices via standard Bluetooth HID profile.
BLUETOOTH_SCAN Enables discovering nearby Bluetooth devices for pairing. Configured with neverForLocation flag.
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE Maintains a persistent Bluetooth HID connection so you can control your PC or run the jiggler while switching apps.
POST_NOTIFICATIONS Displays connection state and quick control shortcuts directly in the Android notification shade.
WAKE_LOCK Prevents Android CPU sleep while an automated Mouse Jiggler session is actively running.
ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION (Android 11 and older) Required solely by older Android OS versions to perform Bluetooth discovery. Location data is never accessed, tracked, or stored.

4. Third-Party Libraries & Services

Remote Mouse Jiggler does not include third-party advertising SDKs, analytics frameworks, or monetization trackers. Open-source libraries used within the app (such as AndroidX Jetpack, Kotlin Coroutines, and Koin) operate entirely offline.

5. Data Security

Because all input signals travel directly between your phone and your target computer via encrypted Bluetooth hardware protocols, your data never traverses the internet, local Wi-Fi networks, or third-party servers.

6. Children's Privacy

The application does not collect any personal identifiable information from anyone, including children under the age of 13.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may periodically update our Privacy Policy. Any updates will be published directly on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.

8. Contact Us

If you have questions or feedback regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:

privacy@heymeowcat.is-a.dev or support@heymeowcat.is-a.dev
